proposal.payload_json: {"interpretations":[{"basis":"Section H states 'Before an UPDATE, obtain explicit confirmation.' This is grammatically an imperative creating an obligation to perform confirmation. The violation is the omission of confirmation itself (failure to obtain it), not the commission of the action. The existing readings model the violation as 'action AND NOT confirmation_before,' requiring the action to occur for a violation. Under this reading, the absence of confirmation is the violation in the context of an UPDATE, independent of whether the action is ultimately performed.
